source.queue_precondition: selected jobs queued with attempt_count 0 at selection time

selection_configuration.method: two untouched queued venues per region; one known source website and one missing; greedy venue-type balancing with seeded SHA-256 tie breaks
selection_configuration.municipality_size_basis: canonical venue count in the pinned national Overture inventory, not resident population
selection_configuration.tourism_basis: operator-designed sampling focus; verify during manual review; not an official tourism statistic

run_limits.quota_behavior: durable pause; never convert quota exhaustion to a result or review label

scenarios.cold: isolated pilot database and empty HTTP/search caches
scenarios.warm_incremental: reuse the cold pilot database and caches; share the same 72-request ceiling

authorization.next_gate: rebuild and fingerprint isolated pilot before any live request

review_label_schema.null_policy: null means not yet manually reviewed; it is never a negative label
